name: Slideshow Perspective Flip
description: Full-screen image slideshow where the next slide flips in from deep 3D perspective while the current one slides away, driven by wheel, touch, drag or arrow buttons.
contents: Scroll hint text and previous/next round arrow buttons
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer drag move to the next or previous slide
Incoming slide rotates, scales and travels in Z with an inner image zoom settle
Loops endlessly and ignores input while a transition runs
editableByProps: Images, background and text colors, hint text
Transition timing, easing, rotation, scale, depth and perspective
Wheel sensitivity, nav button visibility, size and colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change arrow glyphs on the buttons
Change the slide exit direction or axis
needsCodeEdit.where: yPercent tween on currentSlide in navigate

fixed: Observer captures wheel, touch and pointer input over the slideshow container
Slideshow fills the viewport height (h-screen), override with className
